utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the logistics—do we have a clear plan for who’s bringing what and when?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — let’s make it simple: I can bring the tool box and extension cords, and we can set a quick drop-off time for everyone else so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds better. Can we set a single drop-off window and maybe a quick checklist so I know what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help coordinate around school pickup times—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I’m still getting the details together, but I’ll send you the latest once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — just send it when you can, and I’ll work around pickup and after-school timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just send me the time and what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll pass that along as soon as I hear back. Thanks, Bo—really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem—happy to help. Just text me when you know the time and any tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Jules — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need done first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Leo — first thing we need is someone to sort the donated tools by type and check what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle that — I’ll sort the tools by type and make a missing-items list. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — we could really use an extra pair of hands sorting donations and hauling a few boxes. If you’re free, I’ll put you on the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, put me on the list. I can help sort donations and carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the details before we do anything. What’s the repair drive for, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s for gathering supplies and tools to fix the damaged spots around the block. I just need your help confirming what we already have and what still needs to be picked up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check what we already have and what’s still missing. Do you want me to start with supplies, tools, or both?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to mention that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome — could you help spread the word and maybe bring any spare tools you’ve got? I’m trying to get as many neighbors involved as possible.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that — I’ll spread the word and bring whatever spare tools I can find. If I forget anything, just give me a nudge!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we still need help checking porch steps, patching a few fence boards, and seeing who needs small household fixes. If you’re up for it, I can put you on a quick list and match you with the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please put me on the list — I’m happy to help with the porch steps and a few household fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive details—where should I note the location and when do you need it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Note it at the community center, and I need it by Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the community center and make sure it’s ready by Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the repair drive plan moving and let folks know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet — can you confirm what’s already been collected?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure either — I’ll check what’s been collected and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’d like to keep it simple: first we’ll sort the tools, then we’ll check the list of repairs, and after that we’ll make the rounds together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll help sort the tools first, then we can go through the repair list and make the rounds together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what’s the first step, and when do we start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s start by checking what needs fixing and who can help. Once we have that list, we can pick a day and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll make the list today, and then we can pick a day that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m headed out for errands, but I heard the repair drive’s getting some good momentum. If you want, I can check in on what still needs doing when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh? So the repair drive’s actually moving along now? If you check, can you confirm what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I’ll check when I’m back and confirm what’s still needed. I’ll let you know if they need hands, supplies, or anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll skim them now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—I'll grab the repair drive list and bring you the supply details next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, send the list over when you’ve got it—I’ll skim the supply details and jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ve got the repair drive on my list, and I can help keep everything organized. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the biggest broken item and list what parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good call — let’s start with the biggest broken item and note every part we’ll need. If you tell me what’s broken, I’ll help turn it into a clear parts list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Mara—what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you handle the tool table and check the donation boxes when folks arrive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll handle the tool table and check the donation boxes when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m putting together the repair drive invite list—want me to loop you in with the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, please loop me in. I’m happy to help with the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and add you to the invite list. If you want, I can also share the draft plan so you can weigh in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t logged any repair-drive locations yet, but I can keep track of them as we go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good—I'll keep an ear out and pass along any spots I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell—just tell me the spot and I’ll jot it down right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m glad you brought it up; I was just thinking about it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m going to bring the tools list and check who still needs help. Then I’ll swing by after lunch and we can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll keep an eye out and help sort things once you get back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect the groups and keep the repair drive moving—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I think the next thing is just getting a quick list of the groups and who’s bringing what. I might be missing a detail, but I can send it over as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send me whatever you’ve got, and I’ll help turn it into a clean list of groups and supplies. If you’re missing a detail, I can still help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good turnout already. If you want, I can pass along the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess—please pass them along. I can bring my toolkit if there’s anything still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be perfect, Gus — I’ll tell folks you can help with your toolkit. I’m hearing they still need a few hands for sorting and checking what’s fixable.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I have everything right before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what part do you want me to confirm first: the date, location, or what items we’re collecting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s start with the date and location, please. Then tell me exactly what items we’re collecting.
